## The prompt it sends

This is what the tool asks a model, with every option left at its default. Changing the options above changes this text.

```text
Analyze the layout and structure of this document/image.

Detect these elements: headers, paragraphs, tables, images, lists

Return as JSON:
{
    "page_type": "<document/form/article/presentation/other>",
    "columns": <number of columns>,
    "elements": [
        {"type": "<headers|paragraphs|tables|images|lists>", "content": "<brief content summary>", "position": "<top/middle/bottom>"},
        ...
    ],
    "hierarchy": [
        {"level": 1, "type": "<element type>", "content": "<summary>", "children": [...]},
        ...
    ],
    "reading_order": "<left-to-right/top-to-bottom/columns/complex>"
}

Return ONLY valid JSON.
```
